mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tb_translation_region (task_id, region_no, x, y, width, height, original_text, status) VALUES
(#{item.taskId}, #{item.regionNo}, #{item.x}, #{item.y}, #{item.width}, #{item.height}, #{item.originalText}, COALESCE(#{item.status}, 'PENDING'))
mapper.select: SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_translation_region WHERE task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY status

SELECT t.task_no AS taskNo, t.status AS taskStatus, r.region_no AS regionNo, r.original_text AS originalText, r.translated_text AS translatedText FROM tb_translation_task t JOIN tb_translation_region r ON r.task_id = t.id WHERE t.task_no = #{taskNo} ORDER BY r.region_no
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_translation_task t SET progress = sub.pct FROM ( SELECT task_id, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'TRANSLATED') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS pct FROM tb_translation_region WHERE task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY task_id ) sub WHERE t.id = sub.task_id
